title: Financial Inclusion, ICT Diffusion and Poverty Reduction: Evidence from Sub-Sahara African Countries

paper_level.sample_description: 27 SSA countries, 2004-2017, mostly low and lower-middle income
paper_level.technology_measure_main: Internet penetration and mobile subscriptions per 100 people
paper_level.outcome_main: Household final consumption expenditure per capita (constant 2010 US$), used as poverty proxy
paper_level.units_note: Not stated; authors read positive coefficient as poverty reduction

notes: Outcome is poverty (household consumption as proxy), not output or productivity; GDP per capita appears only as a control. Eligible exposure and 27 economies, but no output/productivity estimates, so empty estimates list per rule 6.
